decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom is a high-value system scheduled for full release in Q1/2019, so the firm will keep investing in it rather than withdraw it.
Small volume ionization chambers are core consumable-like dosimetry products with long lifecycles and steady demand for small-field and SRS QA.
This small volume chamber complements the firm's dosimetry portfolio, and such detectors typically stay on the market for many years.
Standard clinical ionization chambers with several models are a staple of absolute dosimetry and calibration services, so they are unlikely to be discontinued.
Relative dosimetry chambers support water phantom scanning workflows and integrate with the firm's systems, which gives them long-term relevance.
Thimble chambers are established reference instruments tied to the accredited calibration business and show low discontinuation risk.
